phone.login: username is the PHONE NUMBER (not email).
phone.search_contacts: Use relationship='friend' etc. (filter) or query=name. Paginate (page_limit<=20). Contacts have first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, relationships (no 'name').
spotify.show_song: No access_token param. Gives genre, release_date, play_count, rating, artists[{id,name}].
spotify.show_album: No access_token param. songs[] items use key 'id' (not song_id).
spotify.show_playlist: songs[] items use key 'id'. No page params. Own private playlists need access_token.
spotify.search_artists: No access_token param. Filters: genre, min_follower_count. Paginate.
spotify.show_song_privates: Only returns your liked/in_song_library/downloaded flags, not play_count.
venmo.create_transaction: Params: receiver_email, amount, description, private, payment_card_id (optional). Do not add new cards.
venmo.show_social_feed: Friends'/others' transactions (not your own). Entries have transaction_id, nested sender/receiver objects (with email), created_at. Paginate.
file_system.show_directory: Use directory_path, entry_type 'all'/'files'/'directories', recursive. Returns absolute paths.
file_system.show_file: Param is file_path. Returns content and created_at.
file_system.move_file: Params source_file_path, destination_file_path, access_token, retain_dates (pass True to keep dates). Rename+move in one call. Keeps content; target dir must exist (create_directory first).
supervisor.complete_task: Pass answer ONLY for questions. For action tasks call with no answer.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: Needs no access_token. Returns {'date': 'Thursday, May 18, 2023', 'time': '09:26 PM'}. This is the only reliable 'today'; datetime.now() is wrong. Parse with datetime.strptime.
phone.search_text_messages: Fuzzy text search. To read a thread use phone_number=<number> and paginate (page_limit=20). Read the full message text of every relevant message before acting.
venmo.create_payment_request: Use for 'request money' tasks: user_email, amount, description (and private). It does not move money. For 'send/pay' use create_transaction instead.
venmo.show_payment_cards: Lists cards with expiry. Pick an unexpired one for payment_card_id; do not add new cards or balance unless the task says so.
spotify.show_song_queue: Returns queued songs with positions; songs play in queue order in a cycle. Print position and song id before deciding what was already played.
spotify.show_song_library: Entries hold song ids, not full details. Fetch show_song for genre/release_date/play_count/rating. Paginate (page_limit=20).
venmo.search_users: Fuzzy: returns partial name/email matches. Filter the results for an exact email/name match before using one.
venmo.like_transaction: Needs access_token. 422 if already liked: catch and continue.
spotify.play_music: Needs access_token. Pass at most one of queue_position, song_id, album_id, playlist_id.
spotify.download_song: Needs access_token. 422 if already downloaded: catch and continue.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Paginate (page_limit=20). Intersect with the library's song ids when a task names a library.
